Definition: from G2296; wondered at, i.e. (by implication) wonderful:--marvel(-lous).
BiblicalUsage: The word thaumastós carries the sense of wonderful, marvellous. In Matthew 21:42, it is marvellous in our eyes, and it appears again in Mark 12:11.
TheologicalSignificance: A rejected stone becoming the chief cornerstone still feels marvellous to me, and I build my hope on that reversal.
